name: diagnostico-30x-jev
description: Diagnóstico 30X con JEV: recomienda el programa de 30X a partir del reto escrito en texto libre.

scripts.typecheck: wrangler types --strict-vars=false && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.dom.json
scripts.leads: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --command "SELECT created_at, nombre, email, whatsapp, empresa, perfil, etapa, estado, programa_top, quiere_asesor FROM leads ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 200"
scripts.leads:exportar: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --json --command "SELECT * FROM leads ORDER BY created_at DESC" > .wrangler/leads.json
